page_title: Your internet. A little more you.

summary.name: Vane
summary.one_liner: Vane is a native macOS web browser modeled on Arc, with sidebar tabs, Spaces, split view, and small "Little Vane" windows.
use_cases: separate work and personal browsing on a Mac
keep reference pages beside your work
open links in a small window without leaving main browsing
switch from Arc to a native Mac browser
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Vane as a native Mac browser designed in the style of Arc. Spaces provide separate areas for work, personal tabs, and other groupings. Split View shows a reference page alongside the main work. Little Vane opens a link in a small separate window without leaving the main window. The page also lists Live Folders as a feature, but gives no details on how they work. A download button for macOS is provided, with no pricing or version information shown.
notable: Arc-style sidebar tabs and Spaces on a native Mac app
Split View for keeping a reference beside work
Little Vane small windows for links
caveats: Only macOS is mentioned; no Windows, Linux or iOS support is named.
Pricing and licensing are not stated on the page.
